summary: 100-foot steel tower in Winston County, Alabama, administered by the Alabama Forestry Commission; NHLR-registered 2016. No build date or current status found.

facts.status_note: Register description dates to its 2016 registration: it no longer houses communications equipment and a tree grows through it. Current condition not confirmed.

events.note: Registered May 27, 2016 as US 1134, AL 67; nominated by Andrew Zerbe
Register description: formerly housed communications equipment, no longer as of 2016

sources.title: Thomas Kaufmann: Keeping Alabama's historic lookout towers

notes_for_editor: Thin record: the NHLR detail page is the only substantive source. Its 2016 description is the latest word on condition, so current status, access and climbing rules are unverified. No build date, designer or staffing history in any source read; the easternuslookouts.weebly.com page guessed at as boar-tush.html returned 404 and was not used. A Facebook video titled 'Boar Tush Lookout Tower in Haleyville, Alabama' appeared in search; it is unread and unused, and Haleyville is the nearest town to the NHLR coordinates. Grokipedia and Wikipedia's Boar Tush community article were checked and do not add tower history. The 1819 News column is by Kaufmann, who may have nominated sites on the Register; it is cited only for general Alabama tower condition and climbing rules. Height 30.5 m converts the NHLR's 100 ft. No photos added. No corrections to the brief's record; access 'unknown' kept.
